versions.changelog:
Initial release of turing-shikuan-demo, focusing on product image recognition via turing-shikuan-mcp.

- Supports product category, brand, series, and brief info extraction from image URLs using turing-shikuan-mcp
- Provides step-by-step setup instructions and guides for first-time configuration (API Key/Secret setup, `setup.sh`)
- Ensures strict distinction: only “识款” (product recognition), not authenticity, quality, or value judgments
- Enforces a fixed output template and refusal to guess or supplement missing information
- Includes robust error handling for unconfigured MCP, missing/invalid URLs, incomplete responses, and out-of-scope requests
